[[Bazzr's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Bazzr Dustwing]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mourning Veil Falls]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Restoration Magic]] spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +60

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[staves]]:
**[[Spawning Staff]] from collector [[Dye Master Franjek]]
**[[Lotus Staff]] ([[Spawning Power]]/[[Restoration Magic]]) from collector [[Denos Makaluum]]
**[[Restoration Staff]] from crafters [[Manzo]] or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
